title: Registration Tenure Courtesy — Community Rules & Site Care Resident Terms
content:
A registration tenure courtesy settles the registration-year fee of a pet under Community Rules & Site Care from its subtotal: the amount reached once the pet's rate, every addition and any credit have been applied, never less than zero. Tenure is counted in whole calendar months from the lease move-in date on the Home-Site Lease to the handling date, and returned payments are counted on the Home-Site Lease ledger within the 12 calendar months ending on the handling date.

1. With at least 180 months of tenure and no returned payment, the fee is half the subtotal, rounded down to the whole dollar.
2. When the first condition does not hold but the resident has at least 60 months of tenure and at most one returned payment, the fee is 0.75 times the subtotal, rounded up to the whole dollar.
3. Otherwise the fee is the subtotal.

## Combinations

| Tenure (whole calendar months) | Returned payments in the 12 months | Rule that settles the fee |
|---|---|---|
| 180 or more | none | 1 — half, rounded down |
| 180 or more | one | 2 — 0.75 times, rounded up |
| 180 or more | two or more | 3 — the subtotal |
| 60 to 179 | none or one | 2 — 0.75 times, rounded up |
| 60 to 179 | two or more | 3 — the subtotal |
| fewer than 60 | any | 3 — the subtotal |

## Worked case

Hypothetical subtotal of $55.00:

- under rule 1, half is $27.50, rounded down to $27.00;
- under rule 2, 0.75 times $55.00 is $41.25, rounded up to $42.00;
- under rule 3, the fee is $55.00.

A resident with 179 months of tenure and no returned payment falls under rule 2; at 180 months the same resident falls under rule 1.
